title: Tech Note: Toggle Switches in 4D
author: Timothy Tse, Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.

historical_commentary.text: The On Mouse Up event and Is waiting mouse up command introduced in v16 are still supported; the manual picture-swap toggle technique remains valid classic-form UI code, though modern 4D form objects (and web-based front-ends) offer native switch/toggle controls that make this DIY approach less necessary today.
